Please be with you soon.

You can thank your stars and (?) LISA that you have been allowed to enter England.

My immigration was thoroughly difficult. ... It is more important that (?) LISA should receive her memorandum. Find out if we can know to whom she has sent it. It would be adorable to send it not only in Scandinavian, but also to be English, Dutch & French.

May we publish her work?

... Many thanks for the letters from Frau MICHAELIS.

Your letter to T (?) T. was short & reasonable. I have seen him only once since your departure.

... How is our old friend (?) BEER?

... Refers to a lecture given by one FRIEDLAND.

... I have an old acquaintance in London, an accountant just. His name is Maurice (?) RAPAPORT

PTO
